H1_elite_bias.title: H1: Elite Reviewer Rating Bias & Variance Reduction
H1_elite_bias.null_hypothesis: Elite and Regular users have identical mean star ratings and rating variance.
H1_elite_bias.conclusion: Elite users assign significantly higher mean ratings with substantially lower variance (fewer extreme 1-star rants) compared to regular users.

H2_city_category_heterogeneity.title: H2: Geographic (City) and Category Rating Heterogeneity
H2_city_category_heterogeneity.null_hypothesis: Mean business review ratings are invariant across metropolitan cities and primary categories.
H2_city_category_heterogeneity.conclusion: Ratings differ significantly across cities and categories: hospitality/tourism hubs (Santa Barbara, New Orleans) exhibit significantly higher average ratings than industrial/commuter hubs.

H3_length_usefulness.title: H3: Review Text Length & Community Usefulness Impact
H3_length_usefulness.null_hypothesis: Review text length has no monotonic association with useful votes or elite status.
H3_length_usefulness.conclusion: Longer, detailed reviews strongly correlate with community 'useful' votes, and elite reviewers write significantly longer reviews than non-elite users.
